title: UK zero-rates VAT on domestic electricity in Great Britain (SI 2026/987, in force 01 October 2026) — a dated, legislated, government-quantified -0.10pp cut to CPI
source: NEWS: THE PREFIX UNDERSTATES THE EVIDENCE AND IS A TAXONOMY ARTIFACT, NOT A DOUBT ABOUT THE DATE — THIS ONE IS LAW. Primary, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200): legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/987/made, The Value Added Tax (Supplies of Domestic Electricity) Order 2026 — 'Made 7th September 2026', 'Laid before the House of Commons 8th September 2026', 'Coming into force 1st October 2026', enabling powers sections 29A(3), 30(4) and 96(9) of the Value Added Tax Act 1994, effect 'for supplies made in the period beginning with 1st October 2026 and ending with 31st March 2027'. Corroborated the same session from a second, independent primary: HMRC's own tax information and impact note, gov.uk/government/publications/temporary-zero-rate-of-vat-for-domestic-electricity-in-great-britain (first published 2026-09-08T17:00+01:00, fetched via the gov.uk content API), 'Operative date | The measure will have effect from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027', signed by James Murray MP, Financial Secretary to the Treasury. Two further primaries on the record: the gov.uk announcement of 21 July 2026 quantifying the effect at 'around 0.10 percentage points' of CPI and 0.14pp of RPI, and Ofgem's 26 August 2026 October-cap press release ('The Government's decision to remove VAT from all domestic electricity bills is reflected in this update'). Filed estimate on the same taxonomy count as every other non-US entry on this calendar: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix list (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for legislation.gov.uk, HMRC or any other foreign tax authority, and NEWS: is the only estimate prefix that is not a pure reasoning estimate. Proposed 2026-09-09 by the uk-cpi-2026-09-16 lane; researched and made canonical by its own lane the same day
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-09, superseding proposals/uk-electricity-vat-zero-rate-2026-10-01.from-uk-cpi-2026-09-16.json (read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md). The proposer's finding stands: this is a policy EFFECTIVE DATE, not a print — the rarest thing a macro calendar gets, a mechanical pre-announced government-quantified move in a national CPI series. WHAT THE INITIAL RESEARCH ADDED, AND IT IS THE POINT: THE PROPOSAL SAID 'ANNOUNCED'; IT IS NOW LAW. SI 2026/987 was made 7 September and laid 8 September, the day before this research. It needs no further parliamentary act to take effect — none of VATA 1994 s.97(4)'s made-affirmative limbs is engaged (s.97(4)(c)(i) increasing the rate, (ii) excluding credit, (iia) varying Sch 7A so VAT is charged at the STANDARD rate, (iii) varying Sch 8/9 so as to ABOLISH zero-rating), because the Order does the opposite of all four: it inserts a new Group 24 into Schedule 8 for Great Britain and narrows Schedule 7A to Northern Ireland. It therefore falls to s.97(5), the negative procedure — in force on 1 October unless the Commons annuls it. THE STRUCTURAL ASYMMETRY THAT FALLS OUT: this cut was easy to make and would be HARD TO WITHDRAW EARLY, since an order abolishing the new zero rate WOULD be caught by s.97(4)(c)(iii) and need a Commons approval vote within 28 days. THE SIZE REPRODUCES INDEPENDENTLY from ONS's own published weights: CPI electricity weight 2026 = 20.6065 per 1000 (ONS series CJXA, fetched 2026-09-09) x 5/105 = 4.7619% VAT-inclusive price fall = 0.098pp, which is gov.uk's 'around 0.10 percentage points' exactly. RPI reproduces less cleanly: weight 27 per 1000 (series CZXL) gives 0.129pp against a stated 0.14pp, a 0.011pp gap this lane could not close from published weights. THE ONE REAL UNCERTAINTY IS PASS-THROUGH, AND HMRC ITSELF DECLINES TO ASSERT IT — the TIIN says households benefit 'subject to the degree to which these businesses pass the VAT savings on to their customers'. Ofgem's cap removes the hedge for capped tariffs: the October-December cap is set VAT-inclusive and already embeds the removal, which is why electricity bills 'remain broadly stable' while gas rises 8%. HMRC PUBLISHED NO EXCHEQUER COSTING — the TIIN's impact table is empty, deferred to OBR certification 'at a future fiscal event', which is uk-autumn-budget-2026-10-28. Press figures near GBP 850m have no primary source in the TIIN. NOT A 1 OCTOBER EVENT FOR ANYONE: the effective date produces no print. The first observable is the ONS October 2026 CPI bulletin, 2026-11-18 07:00 London (ONS release page, fetched) — AFTER the 05 November MPC vote, so the committee forecasts it rather than sees it. THE REFINEMENT THIS LANE ADDS TO THE SIBLING'S 'TAKE THE UNDER ON THE Q4 PEAK': the cut is a LOOK-THROUGH event by construction — a 6-month notch that reverses on 1 April 2027 (the sunset is inside the Order; extension needs a fresh SI) — so it is weaker evidence for a dovish MPC path than its headline size suggests. Tiered LOW: symbols [], and the whole calendar tracks eight US mega-caps (AAPL AMZN AVGO CRWV GOOG META MRVL MSFT) with no UK listing, no utility and no rates or sterling instrument. NI is excluded (Windsor Framework; Sch 7A narrowed to NI), so the CPI effect is GB-weighted — worth well under 0.01pp of shave, below CPI's published 0.1pp precision. Estimate widens caution only; nothing date-keyed may act on this. Ledger: docs/research/events/uk-electricity-vat-zero-rate-2026-10-01.md
